in_sanskrit.name: Asab
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Without Sorrow
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Asab एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Asab is derived from the Sanskrit language and is composed of two parts - 'A' and 'Sab'. 'A' means 'without' and 'Sab' means 'sorrow'. Thus, the name Asab means 'Without Sorrow'. This name is often given to children born during difficult times as a symbol of hope and positivity.
